sources.title: Nisbets Essentials Toaster Grill CT917 - Advantage Catering Equipment
Nisbets Essentials Quartz Toaster Grill CT917 - Easy Equipment

ct917.summary: A compact electric salamander-style toaster grill that heats from above and below with six quartz tubes, controlled by a dial timer and dial thermostat. It suits cafes, small kitchens and pubs for toasting, grilling and finishing dishes on a 13 A plug.

highlights.text: Six quartz heating tubes give simultaneous top and bottom heat.
Three top and three bottom quartz tubes; manual dial temperature and timer.
Removable shelf with handle and integrated side vents.

facts.label: Replacement parts
facts.value: AJ262 control knob, AK014 timer, AK015 position switch, AK016 quartz tube, AK017 rubber feet (x4)

ct917.notes: Weight conflict: 7 kg (Advantage) vs 9.17 kg (Easy Equipment, possibly shipping weight). The user manual PDF was opened but gave no readable text. Caterkwik's 230V not seen on either page.
